question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Lull
solution: The correct answer is '**Calm**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Lull**' is '**Calm**'. • **Lull**: to make somebody relaxed and calm. (किसी को शांत करना) • *Example: She sang a song to **lull** the children to sleep.* • **Calm**: not excited, worried or angry; quiet. (शांत, चुपचाप) • *Example: Try to keep **calm**—there’s no need to panic.* **Correct Answer:__** *Calm.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Activity**: a situation in which there is a lot of action or movement. (सक्रियता, क्रियाशीलता; गतिविधियों से पूर्ण स्थिति) • **Disturbance**: something that makes you stop what you are doing, or that upsets the normal condition of something. (किसी काम को करने से रोकनेवाली वस्तु अथवा किसी वस्तु की सामान्य दशा को उथल-पुथल करनेवाला, बाधा, गड़बड़ी) • **Noise**: a sound, especially one that is loud or unpleasant. [आवाज़ (विशेषतः ऊँची और अप्रिय), शोर, कोलाहल] 33:T915, The correct answer is **'make out'.**
